Pi_0.name: Generational Reproduction Number
Pi_0.physical_interpretation: Expected secondary district cells produced by a single primary cell over its operational lifespan.

Pi_M.name: Mobilization Strain Ratio
Pi_M.physical_interpretation: Ratio of capital burn tempo to territorial taxation replenishment tempo. For Pi_M >= 0.25, bankruptcy collapse occurs.

Pi_S.name: State Institutional Inertia Ratio
Pi_S.physical_interpretation: Ratio of state administrative capacity reconstruction tempo to tactical conflict tempo.

Gamma.name: Competitive Capacity Margin
Gamma.formula: log(G_I) - log(G_S) = log(M + log(1+F)) - log(C_gov + log(1+S_sec))
Gamma.physical_interpretation: Order parameter governing territorial governance control shifts.
